page.overview:
Who is Mugen Imawano?

Mugen Imawano (忌野 霧幻 Imawano Mugen) is a late-father of both Hyo and Kyosuke. When possessing the body of his eldest son, Hyo, Mugen is final boss in the second entry of Rival Schools, Project Justice, under the name Demon Hyo (デモン雹, Demon Hyō). Additionally, Mugen is also a posthumous overreaching antagonist of Rival Schools series.

Mugen had a loose long white hair and red eyes.

While possessing Hyo, his own eldest son, he wears a long red traditional military pants with a black belt to his waist and black boots. He also wears white gloves and his katana. In contrast from his eldest son, he wields two katanas, with the second one, contains his evil spirit. When the second sword's blade is broken, just as Mugen possessed Hyo, it projects a spiritual blue flame abilities.

According to Raizo and Hyo, Mugen is pure evil, tyrant and ruthless than his oldest son.
